name: National Education Policy 2020
title: National Education Policy 2020
description: The National Education Policy 2020 provides a comprehensive framework for transforming India's education system from early childhood care and education through school education and higher education. It focuses on universal access to quality education, foundational literacy and numeracy, holistic and multidisciplinary learning, critical thinking, creativity, problem-solving, vocational education, teacher development, research and innovation, use of educational technology, and equitable opportunities for learners. The policy seeks to replace rigid educational structures with more flexible learning pathways and emphasizes the development of knowledge, skills, values, constitutional awareness, scientific temper and responsible citizenship. It also promotes multidisciplinary higher education, multiple entry and exit opportunities, academic mobility, stronger research ecosystems, Indian languages and greater inclusion of socio-economically disadvantaged groups. The overall vision is to develop an equitable and vibrant knowledge society by providing high-quality education to all learners.

name: National Health Policy 2017
title: National Health Policy 2017
department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: The National Health Policy 2017 provides a framework for improving the health and wellbeing of people in India and seeks to achieve the highest possible level of health for all through preventive, promotive, curative, rehabilitative and palliative healthcare approaches. The policy emphasizes universal access to quality healthcare services without financial hardship and gives importance to strengthening primary healthcare and improving access to secondary and tertiary care. It promotes prevention of diseases, health awareness, sanitation, nutrition, maternal and child health, communicable disease control and management of non-communicable diseases. The policy also recognizes the importance of strengthening the public health system, improving human resources for health, ensuring availability of medicines and diagnostics, encouraging appropriate technology and improving healthcare infrastructure. It seeks to reduce out-of-pocket expenditure and catastrophic health expenditure while encouraging coordination between public and private healthcare providers and greater participation of communities in health-related activities.

Women requiring maternal and reproductive healthcare
Older persons requiring healthcare and support

name: National Environment Policy 2006
title: National Environment Policy 2006
department: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
description: The National Environment Policy 2006 provides a framework for environmental management and sustainable development in India. It seeks to conserve critical environmental resources, protect ecological systems, improve environmental governance and integrate environmental concerns into economic and social development decisions. The policy recognizes that environmental protection and economic development need to be addressed together and promotes the sustainable use of natural resources. It emphasizes conservation of forests, biodiversity, water resources and other ecological assets, prevention and control of pollution, improvement of environmental awareness and strengthening of institutional mechanisms for environmental management. The policy also promotes greater participation of local communities and stakeholders in environmental decision-making and recognizes the importance of improving access to environmental information. It provides guiding principles for balancing development requirements with environmental protection and encourages the use of economic and regulatory instruments to achieve better environmental outcomes.

State governments and local authorities

name: National Water Policy 2012
title: National Water Policy 2012
description: The National Water Policy 2012 provides a framework for planning, development and management of India's water resources. It recognizes water as a scarce and valuable natural resource and emphasizes conservation, efficient utilization, equitable access and sustainable water management. The policy promotes integrated water resource planning across river basins and encourages the efficient use of water in agriculture, industry, domestic consumption and other sectors. It highlights the need to protect water quality, improve groundwater management, increase water-use efficiency and address challenges associated with floods, droughts and climate variability. The policy also emphasizes participation of communities and stakeholders in water management and encourages appropriate pricing, conservation measures and improved governance of water resources. It seeks to balance competing water requirements while maintaining ecological needs and ensuring that water resources are managed in a sustainable manner for present and future generations.

name: National Youth Policy 2014
title: National Youth Policy 2014
department: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
description: The National Youth Policy 2014 provides a framework for empowering India's young population and supporting their overall development and participation in nation building. It defines youth as persons in the age group of 15 to 29 years and focuses on areas including education, employment, skill development, entrepreneurship, health, sports, social values, community engagement and participation. The policy recognizes the importance of providing young people with opportunities to develop their capabilities, obtain appropriate education and skills, access employment and participate meaningfully in economic and social development. It also addresses the needs of disadvantaged and vulnerable young people and encourages greater participation of youth in decision-making, community development and national development activities. The policy seeks to create an environment in which young people can become productive, responsible and active participants in society.

name: National Policy on Skill Development and Entrepreneurship 2015
title: National Policy on Skill Development and Entrepreneurship 2015
department: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: The National Policy on Skill Development and Entrepreneurship 2015 establishes a framework for developing a skilled workforce and creating an enabling environment for entrepreneurship in India. It seeks to provide individuals with access to quality skill development opportunities that improve employability, productivity and income potential. The policy focuses on strengthening institutional capacity, improving the quality and relevance of training, increasing industry participation, recognizing prior learning and expanding access to skill development. On entrepreneurship, it promotes a supportive ecosystem covering entrepreneurship education, mentoring, incubation, access to finance, market support and an improved business environment. It also recognizes the importance of increasing participation of women and disadvantaged groups in skill development and entrepreneurship. The policy aims to align skill development with industry requirements and emerging economic opportunities while encouraging individuals to become both employable and capable of creating employment opportunities.

name: National Policy on Electronics 2019
title: National Policy on Electronics 2019
department: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
description: The National Policy on Electronics 2019 aims to create an environment that enables India to become a global hub for Electronics System Design and Manufacturing. The policy focuses on developing domestic manufacturing capabilities, increasing the production of electronic components and products, encouraging investment, promoting research and innovation, supporting the development of core components such as semiconductors and chipsets, and increasing India's electronics exports. It seeks to strengthen the electronics manufacturing ecosystem through appropriate incentives, infrastructure, technology development and skilled human resources. The policy also aims to reduce dependence on imports, encourage domestic value addition and create employment opportunities in the electronics sector. It supports the development of a competitive electronics industry capable of meeting domestic demand while participating effectively in global supply chains.

name: National Steel Policy 2017
title: National Steel Policy 2017
description: The National Steel Policy 2017 provides policy support for developing a technologically advanced, globally competitive and self-reliant steel industry in India. It covers major areas of the steel sector including demand, production capacity, raw material security, infrastructure, logistics, research and development, energy efficiency, industrial safety and environmental performance. The policy aims to increase domestic steel production and ensure that the country can meet the demand for high-grade automotive steel, electrical steel, special steels and alloys used for strategic applications. It also seeks to reduce dependence on imported coking coal, improve resource efficiency, strengthen research and technology development, improve industrial safety and reduce the carbon footprint of the steel industry. The policy establishes long-term production and capacity objectives for 2030-31 and seeks to strengthen India's position as a competitive global steel producer.

name: National Tourism Policy
title: National Tourism Policy
description: The National Tourism Policy provides a framework for the development, promotion and sustainable growth of tourism in India. It focuses on strengthening tourism infrastructure, improving destination development, enhancing visitor experiences, developing tourism-related skills and employment, promoting sustainable and responsible tourism, and encouraging greater participation of states, local authorities and private-sector stakeholders. The policy framework recognizes tourism as an important contributor to economic growth, employment generation, cultural exchange and regional development. It seeks to improve India's competitiveness as a tourism destination while encouraging preservation of cultural heritage, natural resources and local communities. The policy also emphasizes coordination between central and state governments, tourism organizations, local communities and private tourism service providers to create a stronger and more sustainable tourism ecosystem.

name: National Electric Mobility Mission Plan 2020
title: National Electric Mobility Mission Plan 2020
description: The National Electric Mobility Mission Plan 2020 is a Government of India initiative designed to promote hybrid and electric mobility and support a transition toward cleaner and more energy-efficient transportation. The plan combines several policy measures, including demand-side incentives to encourage consumers to acquire electric and hybrid vehicles, support for research and development in batteries, power electronics, motors and vehicle systems, development of charging infrastructure, supply-side incentives and encouragement of retrofitting existing vehicles with hybrid technology. The mission seeks to strengthen domestic technological capabilities, encourage industry participation and reduce dependence on petroleum-based transportation. It also aims to support the development of an electric and hybrid vehicle ecosystem involving manufacturers, technology developers, infrastructure providers and consumers. The plan represents a coordinated approach to increasing adoption of cleaner vehicle technologies and developing India's electric mobility sector.
